profile.summary: RACCEE (Research About Children of Color in Early Education) is a research evaluation and consulting company founded in 2010. It works with researchers, educators and policymakers on early childhood research that centers anti-racism, offering evaluation consulting, shared tools and resources, and speaking engagements.
